description: Every Readwise and Reader feature, plus a local mirror of your whole library that you can search, triage and dedupe offline.

tools.name: book-tags_create
tools.description: Add a tag to a book. Required: book_id, name. Returns the new Tag.

tools.name: book-tags_delete
tools.description: Remove a tag from a book. Required: book_id, tag_id. Destructive.

tools.name: book-tags_get
tools.description: Get a tag on a book. Required: book_id, tag_id. Returns the Tag.

tools.name: book-tags_list
tools.description: List tags on a book. Required: book_id. Returns array of Tag.

tools.name: book-tags_update
tools.description: Rename a tag on a book. Required: book_id, tag_id, name. Returns the updated Tag.

tools.name: books_get
tools.description: Get a single book/source by ID. Required: id. Returns the Book.

tools.name: books_list
tools.description: List books/sources (rate-limited to 20 req/min; prefer 'sync' for bulk pulls). Page-based response: count, next, previous, results; follow next until null. Optional: page-size (default: 100), page, category (plus 5 more). Returns array of Book.

params.name: updated-after
params.description: Only books last updated after this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: updated-before
params.description: Only books last updated before this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: last-highlight-after
params.description: Only books whose last highlight is after this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: last-highlight-before
params.description: Only books whose last highlight is before this ISO-8601 datetime

tools.name: books_update
tools.description: Update a book/source. Required: id. Optional: title_override, author_override, category (plus 1 more). Returns the updated Book.

params.name: cover_image
params.description: Base64 or data URI image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP); null removes it

tools.name: documents_bulk-update
tools.description: Update up to 50 documents in one request; 20 req/min per token. Returns {results: [...]}; 200 means all succeeded, 207 means partial success/per-item failure (print per-item errors without an error exit), 400 means bad payload. Required: updates.

tools.name: documents_delete
tools.description: Delete a Reader document; 20 req/min per token. Returns 204; also deletes all its highlights and notes. Use a dry-run and confirmation gate before deleting. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: documents_list
tools.description: List Reader documents with filters (rate-limited to 20 req/min; prefer 'sync'). Optional: id, updated-after, location (plus 6 more). Returns array of Document.

params.name: updated-after
params.description: Only documents updated after this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: tag
params.description: Repeat tag query parameter up to 5 times (AND semantics); empty value finds untagged docs. The internal format has no documented repeatable query construct

params.name: with-raw-source-url
params.description: Include raw_source_url field (S3 link valid 1 hour)

tools.name: documents_save
tools.description: Save a document to Reader by URL (or HTML); 50 req/min per token. url is required unless parent_id is set. To create a highlight, supply parent_id and content; only category, content, notes, parent_id, saved_using, tags are accepted. A passage not found in the parent returns 400 and creates nothing. Optional: url, html, clean-html (plus 13 more).

params.name: url
params.description: Document URL; required unless parent_id is set (use a made-up unique URL if none exists)

params.name: html
params.description: Document content as HTML; if omitted Readwise scrapes the URL

params.name: clean-html
params.description: Auto-clean provided HTML and parse metadata

params.name: category
params.description: Document category (default guessed from URL); highlight requires parent_id

params.name: parent_id
params.description: Parent document ID for highlight creation

params.name: content
params.description: Highlight passage in the parent document

tools.name: documents_update
tools.description: Update fields on a Reader document; 50 req/min per token. For highlights only notes and tags are accepted; other keys return 400. Notes cannot be updated directly; update them on their highlight. Required: id. Optional: title, author, summary (plus 9 more). Returns the updated SaveResult.

params.name: reading_progress
params.description: Reading progress fraction, 0 to 1; not yet supported for PDFs

tools.name: highlight-tags_create
tools.description: Add a tag to a highlight. Required: highlight_id, name. Returns the new Tag.

tools.name: highlight-tags_delete
tools.description: Remove a tag from a highlight. Required: highlight_id, tag_id. Destructive.

tools.name: highlight-tags_get
tools.description: Get a tag on a highlight. Required: highlight_id, tag_id. Returns the Tag.

tools.name: highlight-tags_list
tools.description: List tags on a highlight. Required: highlight_id. Returns array of Tag.

tools.name: highlight-tags_update
tools.description: Rename a tag on a highlight. Required: highlight_id, tag_id, name. Returns the updated Tag.

tools.name: highlights_create
tools.description: Create or upsert one or more highlights (creates source books/articles as needed). Dedupe key: title+author+text+source_url. Re-sending the same highlight_url with new text updates the highlight. Required: highlights. Returns array of Book.

tools.name: highlights_delete
tools.description: Delete a highlight. Required: id. Destructive.

tools.name: highlights_get
tools.description: Get a single highlight by ID. Required: id. Returns the Highlight.

tools.name: highlights_list
tools.description: List highlights (rate-limited to 20 req/min; prefer 'sync' for bulk pulls). Page-based response: count, next, previous, results; follow next until null. Optional: page-size (default: 100), page, book-id (plus 4 more). Returns array of Highlight.

params.name: book-id
params.description: Only highlights belonging to this book/source ID

params.name: updated-after
params.description: Only highlights last updated after this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: updated-before
params.description: Only highlights last updated before this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: highlighted-after
params.description: Only highlights taken after this ISO-8601 datetime

params.name: highlighted-before
params.description: Only highlights taken before this ISO-8601 datetime

tools.name: highlights_update
tools.description: Update fields on an existing highlight. Required: id. Optional: text, note, location (plus 2 more). Returns the updated Highlight.

params.name: url
params.description: Unique URL of the specific highlight

tools.name: reader-tags_list
tools.description: List all Reader document tags (20 req/min per token). Optional: page-cursor. Returns array of ReaderTag.

tools.name: review_complete
tools.description: Mark today's daily review complete; returns review_id and review_completed (true).

tools.name: review_get
tools.description: Get today's daily review highlights; 404 means no review today, not a failure. Returns the Review.

novel_features.name: Topic dossier
novel_features.description: Pull every highlight and saved-document passage you have on a topic into one source-attributed, note-ready result.

novel_features.name: Reading backlog and time-budget triage
novel_features.description: See your whole reading debt by location, estimated minutes and age, and pick what fits the time you have.

novel_features.name: Cross-corpus duplicate detection
novel_features.description: Find the same article saved twice, or saved both as a Reader document and as a classic Readwise source.

novel_features.name: Cross-source highlight digest
novel_features.description: Roll up everything you highlighted in a time window across your Readwise books, articles, tweets and podcasts, grouped by source.

novel_features.name: Stale and orphan finder
novel_features.description: Surface forgotten, never-opened saved documents (as Reader IDs you can pass to documents bulk-update) and books with zero highlights.

novel_features.name: What-to-read-next ranker
novel_features.description: Get a short ranked shortlist of unread Reader documents that fit the minutes you have, favouring your preferred location and skipping ones you already started.

novel_features.name: Serendipity connections
novel_features.description: Find items you read months apart that share tags, authors or distinctive terms, from one seed item or across the library.

novel_features.name: Saved-query watches
novel_features.description: Save a query and see only the new matching documents and highlights since the last run.

novel_features.name: Signed webhook delivery
novel_features.description: Register https endpoints that receive new 'watch run --notify' matches, optionally HMAC-signed with a shared secret and SSRF-checked before delivery.
